column1: 定年退職前の仕事で、何度か沖縄を訪れることがあった。その時代、たまたま首里城には行く機会がなかった。定年後、一人で沖縄旅行をし、やっと首里城にも行くことができた。首里城から周りの風景をゆっくり眺めた。仕事仲間と、苦労も楽しみも共にした当時を思い起こした。まだ工事中の箇所もあったので、完成したら是非また行こうと思っていた。
column2: Before retiring, I visited Okinawa several times for work. At that time, I happened to not have the opportunity to go to Shuri Castle. After retiring, I traveled to Okinawa by myself and was finally able to visit Shuri Castle. I took a leisurely look at the surrounding scenery from Shuri Castle. I remembered the times when I shared both hardships and joys with my co-workers. Some parts were still under construction, so I was thinking of going back once it was completed.
column3: 退休前，我曾多次到冲绳工作。当时我正好没有机会去首里城。退休后独自一人去冲绳旅行，终于得以参观首里城。我从首里城悠闲地眺望着周围的景色。我还记得那些与同事们同甘共苦、同甘共苦的时光。有些部分还在建设中，所以我想等完工后再回去。

column1:
首里城では、いつも土砂降りの雨に見舞われます。
直前まではジリジリと太陽が照りつけていても、正殿前まで来ると突然スコール！
この日も大きな雨粒からカメラを守りながらシャッターを切りました。
そのため全体の風景はなく、建物の軒先から装飾の数々をズームで撮ったものばかりです。
column2: Shuri Castle is always hit by pouring rain.  Even though the sun was shining brightly just before, when we got to the front of the main hall, there was a sudden squall!  On this day as well, I pressed the shutter while protecting my camera from large raindrops.  Therefore, there is no overall scenery, but only zoomed shots of decorations taken from the eaves of buildings.
column3: 首里城经常下倾盆大雨。  虽然刚才阳光明媚，但当我们走到大殿前时，却突然刮起了狂风！  在这一天，我一边保护相机免受大雨滴的影响，一边按下了快门。  因此，没有整体风景，只有从建筑物屋檐上拍摄的装饰品的变焦镜头。

column1:
沖縄旅行で初めて首里城に伺いました。
当初、計画には首里城の訪問が含まれていませんでしたが何故か吸い込まれるように首里城に向かいました。正殿が塗り替えられたばかりでとても美しく、沖縄だけではなく日本の宝だと心に刻まれました。火災ニュースをみた際はとてもショックを受けました。でも必ず復元し多くの人を魅了することを確信しています。
column2: I visited Shuri Castle for the first time on my trip to Okinawa.  Initially, my plan did not include a visit to Shuri Castle, but for some reason I was drawn to it and headed there. The main hall had just been repainted and was very beautiful, and it became engraved in my mind as a treasure not only of Okinawa but of Japan. I was very shocked when I saw the news about the fire. However, I am confident that it will be restored and attract many people.
column3: 我在冲绳之旅中第一次参观了首里城。  最初，我的计划不包括参观首里城，但出于某种原因，我被它所吸引并前往那里。正殿刚刚重新粉刷过，非常漂亮，它不仅是冲绳的瑰宝，也是日本的瑰宝，深深地铭刻在我的脑海里。当我看到火灾的消息时，我感到非常震惊。不过，我相信它会恢复并吸引很多人。

column1: 2019年1月3日。復元された直後の首里城を見ました。念願の沖縄旅行。鮮明な記憶の残る中、首里城焼失という惨事のニュースが飛び込み、燃え上がる首里城のニュースを目にするたび驚きと悲しみに包まれました。手元にある写真はごく一部であり、お役に立てることがあればいいなと思い、送らせていただきます。
column2: January 3, 2019. I saw Shuri Castle just after it was restored. A long-awaited trip to Okinawa. While I still had vivid memories, I heard the news of the burning down of Shuri Castle, and every time I saw the news of Shuri Castle burning, I was filled with shock and sadness. The photos I have are only a few, so I would like to send them to you in the hope that they may be of some use to you.
column3: 2019 年 1 月 3 日。我看到了修复后的首里城。期待已久的冲绳之旅。在我记忆犹新的时候，我就听到了首里城被烧毁的消息，每次看到首里城被烧毁的消息，我都充满了震惊和悲伤。我的照片只有几张，所以我想把它们发给你，希望对你有用。

column1: 姉と初めて沖縄旅行しました。首里城は広くて海が見えて赤い塗りの色がとても綺麗でした。『琉球様式』の御殿や調度品にはワクワク。龍が沢山いて楽しかったです。画像は御殿内部などまだありますので、必要があればご連絡ください。

You will be thrilled by the Ryukyu style palaces and furniture. It was fun to see so many dragons. We still have pictures of the inside of the palace, so please contact us if you need them.

column1:
初めての沖縄でした。那覇に到着して真っ先に首里城に行きました。宮古島で長女の結婚式の前に沖縄本土に泊まり、この日、学生時代の友人が住む名護で会う予定をしていて、次女と首里城にいきました。次女は高校生の修学旅行で一度首里城に行きましたが滞在時間が短かったのでゆっくり見たのは、この日でした。
高校生の時まだ完成していなかったところもゆっくり見て感激したばかりの一週間後にまさかの火災。驚きました。ショックでした。
少しでもお役に立てたなら。
まだ復興に時間がかかると思いますが、完成したらまた首里城に行きたいです。頑張れ沖縄！
column2: It was my first time in Okinawa. After arriving in Naha, the first thing I did was go to Shuri Castle. I stayed in Okinawa mainland before my eldest daughter's wedding in Miyakojima, and on that day, I had plans to meet a friend from my school days in Nago, where she lives, and went to Shuri Castle with my second daughter. My second daughter went to Shuri Castle once on a school trip for her high school students, but since her stay was short, it was on this day that she took her time to see it.  Just a week after I was in high school and had been impressed by the parts that hadn't been completed yet, a fire broke out. I was surprised. It was a shock.  If I could be of any help.  I think it will still take some time to rebuild, but I would like to go to Shuri Castle again once it is completed. Good luck Okinawa!
column3: 这是我第一次来冲绳。到达那霸后，第一件事就是去首里城。大女儿在宫古岛举行婚礼之前，我住在冲绳本岛，那天我本来打算和住在名护的学生时代的朋友见面，然后和二女儿一起去了首里城。二女儿曾在高中生的修学旅行中去过首里城，但由于停留时间较短，所以就在这一天抽出时间参观了。  就在我上高中一周后，我对尚未完成的部分印象深刻，一场火灾发生了。我很惊讶。这是一个震惊。  如果我能帮上什么忙的话。  我认为重建还需要一些时间，但是一旦完成，我想再次去首里城。祝冲绳好运！

column2: It was my first day in Okinawa - spent the evening visiting Shuri Castle. When going to the island I learned that Okinawa is a place with great history and a deep culture - and Shuri Castle is a symbol of that.

column1:
shuri castle was disappointing upon first visit ; it didn't look like it was older than a decade, and not much more than an empty shell. With its freshly carved stones, fake windows and fresh paint, it looked like a disneyland attraction.

Then, when I realized that most temples, gardens, and castles on Okinawa had been erased by WWII; when I realized that, Shuri castle had only recently been revived (my first visit was in 2003) from nearly pole holes on the ground and a couple of pictures after a century of decay ; then I started to understand the value and the symbol of Shuri for the ever enduring uchinanchu.
column2: shuri castle was disappointing upon first visit; it didn't look like it was older than a decade, and not much more than an empty shell. With its freshly carved stones, fake windows and fresh paint, it looked like a disneyland attraction.  Then, when I realized that most temples, gardens, and castles on Okinawa had been erased by WWII; when I realized that, Shuri castle had only recently been revived (my first visit was in 2003) from nearly pole holes on the ground and a couple of pictures after a century of decay; then I started to understand the value and the symbol of Shuri for the ever enduring uchinanchu.
column3: 第一次参观首里城时感到很失望；它看起来并没有超过十年的历史，只不过是一个空壳，有着新雕刻的石头、假窗户和新油漆，看起来就像一个迪士尼乐园的景点。  然后，当我意识到冲绳上的大多数寺庙、花园和城堡都被二战抹去了；当我意识到首里城最近才从地面上的杆洞中恢复过来（我第一次参观是在2003年），经过一个世纪的腐烂后的几张照片；然后我开始理解首里对于永恒的乌奇南楚的价值和象征。

It was a truly wonderful world full of dreams. Shuri Castle attracts many people. Thank you for all the inspiration!

column1:
I visited Shuri Castle with my brother and his friend in Summer 2019 on their first Japan trip.
One of the things we really wanted to do was to see Shuri Castle, as it looks so much different from other castles we have seen. 
It took us two attempts to get in! The first attempt failed because we came 5 minutes after the last admission. We were disappointed but decided we have to try it the next day again, especially now that we have already seen how great it looks from the outside! So the next day we hurried and made it on time. During our visit it started pouring rain and then there was the most beautiful rainbow I have ever seen. We decided to stay even longer to also see the sunset and eventually also the castle with it's illuminations at night. Another great memory I have was the small tea time with okinawan biscuits in the small cafe inside the castle, where you had a great view on the garden. Eventually we were so glad we didn't get accepted last minute the other day, because the time would have never been enough to make all these memories we eventually did afterwards.

column1: 高校2年生の研修旅行で訪れました。提供させていただいた写真からわかるかもしれませんが、これからも世にあり続ける外見よりも中の展示物ばかり楽しんで見ていました。琉球という教科書でしか見ることがなかった展示物を時間をかけて見てしまい、首里城公園の端あたりにいた鳥さんのお散歩を眺めていたらウォークラリーの見回りの先生に早く次に進めと注意された良い思い出です。展示の建物から外を撮った写真は、捕まった風などと称して笑いながら撮った写真です。角度といい影といい、良い塩梅で撮れた写真だという自信があります。
column2: visited on a study trip for my second year high school students. As you may be able to tell from the photos I provided, I was more interested in seeing the exhibits inside than looking at the exterior, which will continue to be a part of the world. I spent a lot of time looking at an exhibit called Ryukyu that I had only seen in textbooks, and as I was watching a bird walk around the edge of Shuri Castle Park, the walk rally instructor told me to move on to the next one quickly. I have a good memory of being warned. The photo of the outside of the exhibition building was taken while laughing, calling it the captured wind. I am confident that the photo was taken with the right angle and shadow.
column3: 我参加了高中二年级学生的学习旅行。正如您从我提供的照片中可以看出的那样，我更感兴趣的是内部的展品，而不是外部，外部将继续成为世界的一部分。我花了很多时间观看了一个在教科书上见过的名为“琉球”的展览，当我在首里城公园的边缘观看一只鸟在散步时，步行拉力赛的教练告诉我快点去下一个我对被警告的事记忆犹新。展览馆外面的照片是笑着拍的，称之为捕捉风。我确信这张照片是用正确的角度和阴影拍摄的。

When living in Yokohama I took a short trip to Okinawa and was really very charmed by the place. I heard about the Shuri-jo fire very recently on the NHK world service and was very saddened by this. Notre Dame got so much coverage for their fire but I hadn't heard anything on this. 

I understand the Ryukyu people are a distinct cultural group from mainland Japan and that Shuri-Jo is the pride of the people. I hope for Okinawa, and as a world heritage site, the castle comes back better than ever.

column1:
当時、俺は、中学生でした、地元のプログラムによって、多くの人数の人が船で、沖縄へ行きました。
バスガイドさんが、バスの中で「龍が首里城には、いっぱいあり、龍を写真に収めましょう！」と言ったのを昨日の事のように思い出されます。
天気は、あいにくの曇り空だったのですが、沖縄は、地元とは違う建築物があり、当時の俺には、刺激的に写りました。
人々は、優しく、温かい土地だと思いました。
教科書で学んだ想像と実際に行くのは、違うものだなと、思ったものです。
大人になると、そんな沖縄に行く機会があった幸運に、感謝の思いが湧くようになりました。
今でも、大切な思い出です。
ありがとう、沖縄と沖縄の人々。
column2: At that time, I was a junior high school student, and a local program sent many people to Okinawa by boat. I remember like it was yesterday when the bus guide said to me on the bus, ``There are so many dragons at Shuri Castle, let's take pictures of them!'' Unfortunately, the weather was cloudy, but Okinawa had architecture that was different from my hometown, and it was very exciting to me at the time. I thought the people were kind and warm. I used to think that what I imagined from textbooks and actually going there was different. As I became an adult, I began to feel grateful for the good fortune I had in having the opportunity to go to Okinawa. Even now, it is a precious memory. Thank you, Okinawa and the Okinawan people.
column3: 那时我还是个初中生，当地的一个节目送了很多人乘船去冲绳。记得就在昨天，巴士上的导游对我说：“首里城的龙真多，我们来拍张照片吧！”可惜天气阴天，但冲绳有和家乡不一样的建筑，当时让我很兴奋。我认为这里的人们都很友善、热情。我曾经以为课本上想象的和实际去的不一样。当我长大后，我开始感激自己有幸有机会去冲绳。即使现在，这也是一段珍贵的回忆。谢谢冲绳和冲绳人民。

column2: At first, I met a group of Japanese university students at Tenshikan, which is on the right hand side of the main hall, and after talking with them about ancient etiquette, they invited me to take a tour with them, and they became my travel companions. After visiting the three shrines of Shuri Castle and walking around Akada Town, we all got sunburned, and when we woke up the next day, our skin was bright red and stinging.
